content: Official WordPress Theme Handbook treats themes as presentation owners and documents child-theme precedence for theme templates; plugin template behavior must be intentionally provided by the plugin. GigPress has its own gigpress_template() child theme → parent theme → wp-content → bundled template resolver and optional theme gigpress.css. Responsive public output should improve CSS and semantics within existing classes/files or preserve template resolver path, names, passed variables, and documented CSS disable/override options. Confidence MEDIUM: docs and existing GigPress implementation cross-checked.
